column1: # gh-post: is this key's marker the body's LAST non-blank line, exactly? Read by
# BOTH ports (marker_matches / Test-MarkerMatch). It decides which post a re-run
# edits, so a false yes edits another party's post and a false no posts a duplicate.
# "-" means an empty string; "\n" in a body is a newline.
see <!-- pipeline:gate/x --> for how it works
